## Unique Pokémon That Learn Psychic via Level-Up in Gen 1:

| Pokémon | Team Source | Type | Level Learned |
|---------|-------------|------|---------------|
| **Kadabra** | Sabrina (Saffron City Gym) | Pure Psychic | Level 38 |
| **Alakazam** | Sabrina (Saffron City Gym) | Pure Psychic | Level 38 |
| **Slowbro** | Lorelei (Elite Four #1) | Water/Psychic | Level 55 |

---

Many Psychic-type Pokémon from these teams **do NOT** learn Psychic by level-up in Gen 1:

- ❌ **Starmie** (Misty's Pokémon) - Must use TM29 (Psychic)
- ❌ **Jynx** (Lorelei's Pokémon) - Must use TM29 (Psychic)
- ❌ **Mr. Mime** (Sabrina's Pokémon) - Must use TM29 (Psychic)

In Gen 1, there was only **one TM for Psychic (TM29)** available in Saffron City, and players often had to choose whether to use it on their team members who couldn't learn it by level-up or save it for trading purposes.

Only **Kadabra**, **Alakazam**, and **Slowbro** from the Gym Leader/Elite Four teams naturally learn the Psychic move through level progression without requiring a TM.
